caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a high back and armrests, positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The chair has three horizontal slats on the backrest and features a woven seat in shades of green and tan, forming a geometric pattern with diagonal lines. The wood frame of the chair is shown in shades of brown with hints of red and yellow, and includes turned details on the arms and front stretcher. The chair stands on four tapered legs, with the front legs including decorative turnings and a pinkish central spindle. The drawing is rendered with visible colored pencil strokes, and the chair casts a faint blue shadow beneath the legs. There are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Baby's High Chair
